The forgotten history of company building — and a working playbook for founders who want to keep control of what they build. Buy on Amazon Explore the book → “Venture capital can be deadly; this book shows founders what to do about it.” David Frankel · Co-founder, Founder Collective We support founders who turn theory into action. Early-stage capital for people building a better world for everyone — from infrastructure to supply chains. Meet the portfolio Impact reaching beyond the surface We fundamentally reshape broken global systems by connecting the best people reimagining our world to resources and each other. We use early stage capital to upgrade systems. That starts with finding the sectors currently not working with consideration for people, businesses, or general public responsibility - everything from infrastructure to supply chains. Because ensuring our future takes more than reducing carbon emissions.
